variants.prompt: In a penthouse suite bathed in neon club lighting, the exotic beauty exudes confidence and seduction. Her raven tresses are styled in a sleek, high ponytail, emerald eyes gleaming with fiery passion under the harsh, colorful glow. An almost sheer, black lace corset clings to her curves, leaving little to the imagination. Strappy stilettos elevate her stature, while a delicate silver choker encircles her slender neck. The shallow depth of field blurs the cityscape beyond the balcony, drawing the viewer's attention to the striking model's provocative pose and sensual, inviting gaze.
